topic.title: Reformat Against Edit
topic.shortdesc: User A only reformats the file. User B only edits the content. The merge must keep B's edits and must not report the whole file as conflicting.

section.title: Overview
section.p: The Authentication Service validates user credentials and issues signed access tokens. It runs as a stateless component and can be scaled horizontally behind a load balancer.
Tokens are signed with the key configured in auth.signing.key. The service keeps no session data on the local disk, so any instance can serve any request.

section.title: Configuring the service
section.p: The configuration file is read once, at startup. Restart the service after every change.

ul.li: A JDK 21 runtime is installed on the host.
The database schema is migrated to revision 42.
Port 8443 is open for inbound TLS traffic.
